dingdongji.configuration.glowBandEnabled: The glowing band overlay on the metal armor sets. Turn this off if the band renders black or invisible on your GPU.
tooltip.dingdongji.ji_anvil.desc: Breaks enchantment level limits, level-squared cost growth, 10% chance to double enchantments, 20% chance to add curse
tooltip.dingdongji.ji_set: Wearing full set increases mining speed and block interaction range
tooltip.dingdongji.devour: Devour: Kill mobs to increase weapon damage, formula %s
tooltip.dingdongji.accumulate: Burst: Accumulates energy in inventory, +0.2 damage/sec, halved on attack
tooltip.dingdongji.create_template.desc: Versatile: Right-click to switch mode, left-click to return to normal template mode, current mode:
tooltip.dingdongji.create_template.switc: Press [Left Alt] to switch template type
tooltip.dingdongji.royal_steel_affinity: Royal Affinity: Continuously restores wearer's health
tooltip.dingdongji.comfortable: Comfortable: Press [%s] to toggle, walk with greater ease
tooltip.dingdongji.heat_insulation: Wading: Ignore fire damage and see through lava
tooltip.dingdongji.barrier_i: Barrier I: Significantly reduces most incoming damage
tooltip.dingdongji.ember_regen: Ember Rebirth: Regenerates health in lava or fire, doubled in soul fire
tooltip.dingdongji.lava_walker: Lava Walker: Press [%s] to toggle fire trail; Walk on lava by default
tooltip.dingdongji.glowing_vision: Adapt: Press [%s] to switch between highlighting hostiles and night vision; Ignore darkness, fire and freeze damage, adapt to oxygen-free environments; Ignore liquid overlays and fog
tooltip.dingdongji.neutron_barrier: Neutron Cowl: Press [%s] to toggle enemy repulsion; Destroys incoming projectiles
tooltip.dingdongji.barrier_ii: Barrier II: Greatly reduces most damage; Ignores magic damage (potion magic, dragon breath, wither skull, sonic boom), void damage, contact damage (cactus, sweet berry bush, thorns), and explosion damage; Emergency heal at low HP, clearing all negative effects
tooltip.dingdongji.frost_walk: Frost Stride: Press [%s] to toggle reduced friction on blocks, sneaking restores normal friction; Walk on powder snow by default, ignore block friction and slowdown
tooltip.dingdongji.meaningless: Meaningless: Disables all enchantments except specific ones [Hold Left Shift]
tooltip.dingdongji.meaningless.conversio: And converts them into armor and toughness
tooltip.dingdongji.meaningless.shifting: Meaningless: Disables all enchantments except specific ones (%s) and converts them into armor and toughness
tooltip.dingdongji.stride_void_enhanced: Stride Void: Creative flight while worn, press [%s] to toggle overspeed flight; Ignore fall damage, block slowdown and block friction; Walk on the void floor and on fluids
